name: Alisson Becker

career_stints.note: All-competitions total per source (thesportreview.com biography, via web search 2026-08-10). Goals/assists not reported for this stint; omitted rather than assumed.

Serie A only, per Transfermarkt profile fetch 2026-08-10 (37 apps, 28 goals conceded, 17 clean sheets, 3,330 minutes). All-competitions Roma total not separately confirmed. Was second-choice keeper his first season before becoming first choice in 2017/18, when he won Serie A Goalkeeper of the Year.

Premier League appearances only, per Transfermarkt (fetched 2026-08-10, current through the completed 2025/26 season): 255 apps, 106 clean sheets, 22,874 minutes. All-competitions Liverpool total per the same source: 499 appearances, 213 clean sheets, 44,792 minutes since joining 19 July 2018. Scored the first-ever goalkeeper goal in Liverpool's history (95th-minute header vs West Brom, 17 May 2021) -- a career goals total beyond that single well-documented instance was not independently confirmed, so the 'goals' field is omitted here rather than guessed.

notes: 2025/26 season box score (sources: matchbingo.co.uk, sportbusy.com, footystats.org, via web search 2026-08-10): 26 Premier League appearances, 24 goals conceded, 8 clean sheets, 64.77% save percentage; also 6 Champions League appearances, 4 clean sheets. Season-specific minutes could not be cleanly separated from the career PL minutes total (22,874), so playstyle_metrics.minutes is omitted rather than estimated.
